sections.heading: 1. What are Microorganisms
points: **Microorganisms (microbes)** = tiny organisms **not visible to the naked eye**; seen only under a **microscope**.

sub: **Bacteria**, **Fungi**, **Protozoa**, **Algae** — and **Viruses** (which reproduce only inside a host).

points: They live everywhere — air, water, soil, and inside bodies.

sections.heading: 2. Microorganisms as Friends
points: **Curd and cheese** — made by **Lactobacillus** bacteria (curdle milk).
**Fermentation** — **yeast** ferments sugar → alcohol/CO₂ (bread, idli, alcohol).
**Nitrogen fixation** — **Rhizobium** (in legume roots) and blue-green algae fix atmospheric nitrogen → enrich soil.
**Medicine** — **antibiotics** (e.g. penicillin from a fungus) kill/stop microbes; **vaccines** train the body's immunity.
**Decomposers** — break down dead matter and clean the environment.

sections.heading: 3. Microorganisms as Foes
points: Cause **diseases** in humans, animals and plants — **pathogens**.

sub: **Virus:** common cold, influenza, polio, measles, COVID-19.

points: **Carriers/vectors** (e.g. mosquitoes, houseflies) spread diseases; some microbes cause **food poisoning** and **food spoilage**.

sections.heading: 4. Food Preservation and the Nitrogen Cycle
points: **Preservation** stops microbes from spoiling food: **salting, sugaring, drying, boiling/pasteurisation, refrigeration, adding preservatives** (salt, oil, chemicals like sodium benzoate).
**Pasteurisation** (Louis Pasteur) — heating milk then cooling quickly to kill microbes.
**Nitrogen cycle** — nitrogen-fixing bacteria/lightning → nitrates in soil → plants → animals → decomposers → denitrifying bacteria return N₂ to air (kept in balance).

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Microbes: bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae, viruses (virus needs a host).
Curd = Lactobacillus; bread/alcohol = yeast (fermentation); antibiotics (penicillin from fungus).
Nitrogen fixation = Rhizobium (legume roots) + blue-green algae.
Malaria = protozoan via female Anopheles mosquito; TB/cholera/typhoid = bacteria.
Preservation: salting, drying, refrigeration, pasteurisation (Louis Pasteur).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Malaria** is caused by a **protozoan (Plasmodium)** and spread by the **female Anopheles** mosquito.
**Curd** forms due to **Lactobacillus** bacteria; **fermentation** is by **yeast**.
**Rhizobium** fixes nitrogen in the **root nodules of legumes**.
**Antibiotics** work against **bacteria/fungi**, not viruses; viruses are tackled by **vaccines**.
